51289897.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to PDK2 (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by ITC analysis

original_paragraph.Results_section: To verify compounds 11–14 interacted with PDK2, we titrated PDK2 buffer solution with 12 in an isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiment, from which a moderate Kd value of 2.35 μM was obtained (Fig. 5A), indicating 12 interacted directly with PDK2.
original_paragraph.Figure_5_caption: Fig. 5. Compound 12 inhibited PDK2. (A) The ITC titration of 12 into PDK2 solution, from which the binding affinity Kd value was obtained; (B) The EC50 values of 12 against PDK1, 2, 3, and 4, respectively. PDKs kinase activities were measured by the Kinase-Glo® luminescent kinase assay, the ATP consumption was detected in the measurement. (C) Selectivity index was calculated from the EC50 values of 12 against PDK1, 3 and 4 over PDK2. **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.005 versus PDK2 group.
original_paragraph.Figure_5A_data: The ITC thermogram (Fig. 5A) shows the heat released per injection (μcal/sec) over time (min) and the integrated heat (kcal mol⁻¹ of injectant) versus molar ratio. The binding isotherm curve is fitted to a single-site binding model, yielding a Kd value of 2.35 μM.
